description: Header file defining the RunDex2Oat class for executing and configuring the dex2oat compiler in Android's installd component.

classes.name: RunDex2Oat
classes.description: Class responsible for configuring and executing the dex2oat compiler with various options.

methods.name: RunDex2Oat
methods.description: Constructor initializing the RunDex2Oat object with the path to the dex2oat binary and an ExecVHelper instance.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the parameters for running dex2oat, including input/output files and configuration options.

methods.name: Exec
methods.description: Executes the configured dex2oat process with the specified exit code.

methods.name: PrepareBootImageFlags
methods.description: Prepares command-line flags related to boot image configuration.

methods.name: PrepareInputFileFlags
methods.description: Prepares command-line flags for input files such as oat, vdex, image, dex, and profile.

methods.name: PrepareCompilerConfigFlags
methods.description: Prepares compiler configuration flags including instruction set, filter, and API checks.

methods.name: PrepareCompilerRuntimeAndPerfConfigFlags
methods.description: Prepares runtime and performance-related compiler flags.

methods.name: GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value by key, with a default fallback.

methods.name: GetBoolProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean property value by key, with a default fallback.

methods.name: MapPropertyToArg
methods.description: Maps a property to a formatted argument string.

methods.name: MapPropertyToArgWithBackup
methods.description: Maps a property to an argument, with a backup property if the primary is unavailable.
